tours.title: Spirit of Wimmera
details: (SG) – D
from Seymour, Melbourne or North Shore

We make our second journey to Horsham for all the fun, excitement and quirky sights of the Wimmera Steampunk Festival at Dimboola. We will also return to Serviceton for a rare visit to this once important station.
The theme is 19th century space travel.
